INSERT INTO table_access_user_daily ( cluster_id, access_date, db_name, table_name, user_name, access_count, last_access_time ) VALUES
( #{item.clusterId}, #{item.accessDate}, #{item.dbName}, #{item.tableName}, #{item.userName}, #{item.accessCount}, #{item.lastAccessTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_count = access_count + VALUES(access_count), last_access_time = CASE WHEN last_access_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_access_time) WHEN VALUES(last_access_time) IS NULL THEN last_access_time ELSE GREATEST(last_access_time, VALUES(last_access_time)) END
